title: How is Walt Disney connected to JFK?
hook: How is Walt Disney connected to John F. Kennedy?

image.file: File:Walt Disney and Dr. Wernher von Braun - GPN-2000-000060.jpg

links.line: In 1954, Walt Disney teamed up with rocket scientist Wernher von Braun to make films about going to space.
Nine years later, von Braun was showing President Kennedy the rocket that would take America to the Moon.
